## Description {#details}

Generic strongly-typed wrapper for explicit type conversion.

<SectionUser title="Since">
3.2.0
</SectionUser>

The <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/to-t">to&#95;t</a></code> template provides a public, strongly-typed wrapper for any type <code>T</code>, enabling explicit conversion of dynamic values and expressions to a type recognised by the µTest++ comparators and reporting mechanisms.

This wrapper inherits from <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/value">type&#95;traits::value</a>&lt;T&gt;</code>, ensuring that the encapsulated value is treated as the specified type within the framework. It is particularly useful for enhancing type safety and clarity in test expressions, especially when working with user-defined or less common types.


<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing>

<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">MyType obj;</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">auto</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> wrapped = <a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-test-plus-literals/#gaad9720f2d1e443d77cdfd1eb1151e924">to&#95;t&lt;MyType&gt;</a>&#123;obj&#125;; </span><span class="doxyHighlightComment">// Explicitly treat obj as MyType for</span></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><span class="doxyHighlight">test comparison</span></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>


This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
